segments.text: students from Faculty of Tourism of the University of Hanoi. Our team is named
Peroni. Coming to the contest, project on the use and conservation of Asian
World cultural heritage in the context of climate change. Our team would like
to introduce to you about the historical side of Vietnam. The Imperial
Imperial Citadel of Tang Long. The Imperial Citadel of Tang Long is a complex of
relics associated with the history of Tang Long, Dong Qing and Hanoi. This
archaeological site is a living proof of the Red River Delta civilization
spanning its dynasty and still to this day. It has been one of the oldest and
most important historical site of our country. It was built in 1010 and
completed in early 1011. When King Li Taito issued a decree to move the capital
from Halu to Da La. The monument is located at 19th-century Huan Ziu,
it means Ba Ding, Hanoi, with a total area of 18,395 hectares. Tang Long Imperial Citadel
is a complex including many relics, landscapes, cleaning up palaces with a
royal architecture imbued with Oriental cultural identity. Although the
Imperial Citadel of Tang Long is not intact, but it still preserves many
relics such as the archaeological site of 18 Huan Ziu, Quy Thien Palace, Hau Lâu,
Luan Môn, Bac Môn, the system of city works and gates. Some relics are in the
process of being restored. On July 31, 2010, according to the town in Brazil, the
World Heritage Committee of the United Nations Educational Scientific and
Industrial Organizations, uproar a resolution recognizing the central Imperial Citadel of
Tang Long Hanoi in the World Cultural Heritage. The outstanding global values of
this heritage site are recognized by three outstanding features. According to
criteria number two, the artifact on the ground and extrovert in the ground
is a central area of Imperial Citadel of Tang Long Hanoi as a special proof of the
long process of cultural exchange. The place to receive many cultural influences
from outside. Many theories and ideas of universal values of human civilization,
especially Buddhism, Confucianism. According to criteria number three, the
central area Imperial Citadel of Tang Long Hanoi is the only evidence of the
long-standing cultural traditions of the Vietnamese in the Red River Delta
throughout 13th century continuous history and continue until today. According
to criteria number six, the Imperial Citadel of Tang Long Hanoi clearly
demonstrates a heritage that is directly related to many important events
in the history of an ethnic nation in the South Asian Asia in the regional and
the world relations. Over many periods, the Imperial Citadel of Tang Long suffered
from changes. Human impact and climate change, making the current village
facing the risk of degradation requiring conservation measures. The Imperial
Citadel of Tang Long is a tourist study nation located in the center of
Hanoi city. Hanoi has better conditions for preserving
artifacts than many other localities, but the artifact system in Hanoi is
under the influence of climate change. Here the climate is typical for the
northern region with the characteristic of human tropical monsoon
climate. Customers, heavy rains, causing flooding, making many buildings and
break doors to be flooded. The humid atmosphere, especially after the lunar
new year, leads to difficulty in preservation of archaeological sites and
mostly worse. When researching the World Heritage Site of the Imperial Citadel of
Tang Long at the archaeological site of 18 Huan Ziu, Professor Shidao Araki
Cyber University, Japan, found out that there are many wooden artifacts
underneath the Imperial Citadel. Meanwhile, the ground of the monument has
many underground water sources. If water is not regularly drained, the monument
will be flooded and microorganisms will be penetrated, causing negative
impacts on the heritage. To solve this problem, it is necessary to design
a regular drink and water's intake system. Strengthen and start to periodically
take care to underground relics. Dr. Bu Min Chi, director of the Citadel
Research Center, Vietnam Academy of Sociology Sciences, said that hydro
meteorological monitoring equipment, groundwater monitoring and humidity
measurement equipment in some locations in the archaeological area at
18 Huan Ziu gives a result. The relics are facing extremely harsh weather. The
above evidences show that heritage before the impact of climate change is at
risk of being deformed, lost, or even destroyed if we don't have timely
response solutions. There are design measures to lead the underground
water source under the relics to increase humidity. It is recommended to use glossy
paint to cover the relics or put the relics on the museum for better
preservation. Besides, there are also human-caused causes such as littering at
the wrong places causing environmental pollution. The Imperial Citadel is
located in the center of Hanoi capital, so the traffic density is too crowded.
Causing noise pollution for big sister and difficulty in the inter-pre-station work.
Organizing integrated tours with the farm of heritage protection propaganda,
create a page, the Imperial Citadel of Tang Long, the old shadow in the eyes of
modern people, to receive comments on the heritage situation as well as
solutions to protect the heritage. Use posters and promotional image to remind
tourists to have a sense of heritage protection. One important thing is to
promote propaganda to the people, tourists and everyone who is conscious of
environmental protection to reduce the effect of climate change.
